# Opening libraries and reading data

```{r setup}

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

homicides <- read_csv("data/homicide-data.csv")

head(homicides)
str(homicides)

```

# cleaning and preparing data

```{r data}

colnames(homicides)

baltimore_monthly <- homicides %>%
  filter(city == "Baltimore", state == "MD") %>%
  mutate(date = ymd(reported_date),
         month = floor_date(date, "month")) %>%
  group_by(month) %>%
  summarise(homicides = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(season = if_else(
    month(month) %in% 5:10,
    "Summer",
    "Winter"
  ))

head(baltimore_monthly)


```

```{r plot}

ggplot(baltimore_monthly, aes(x = month, y = homicides)) + 
  geom_col(aes(fill = season))

```
